name: sdei-tools
description: Shared Claude Code tooling — parallel code-review specialists and a delivery-lifecycle skill suite

plugins.name: sdei-review
plugins.description: Five parallel code-review specialists (security, correctness, conventions, performance, interface contract) with adversarial verification. Works in any language or framework.

plugins.name: sdei-delivery
plugins.description: Ten skills that carry a project from pre-sales material to production, in any language or framework: project profile, knowledge graph, brownfield onboarding of existing code, user stories with acceptance criteria, database model, documentation, module-scale builds, tests, acceptance validation and deployment — with a human gate at each expensive decision.
